messages:
sara.sec: Heads up — since ~04:30 UTC we've been seeing ap-southeast edge proxies reject a subset of mTLS handshakes. Proxy logs show KMS unwrap permission denies but audit logs don't have the corresponding KMS request IDs. Anyone seeing this?

mike.infra: Seeing the same. Spike in handshake_rejects for ap-southeast. Rolling 5m -> 4xx spikes. Pinged kms-team. :eyes:

alex.runtime: Can you paste a sample proxy log line? Also which TLS profile rolled out yesterday afternoon?

sara.sec: Sample log:
```
proxy[ap-southeast1] ERROR handshake failed: client_cert verify failed: unwrap_error: PERMISSION_DENIED
kms-plugin: deny key=projects/prod/keys/svc-edge-proxy, principal=roles/proxy.edge
trace_id=-
```

ian.oncall: trace_id being '-' suggests the proxy didn't forward the correlation ID. Our audit pipeline drops events without request_id so the KMS events are invisible downstream. Could be RBAC prune removed the proxy principal from kms:Decrypt or the proxy lost the header.

carol.compliance: We didn't manually run a global RBAC prune in APAC. There was an automated scope-shrink job scheduled 2026-03-20-09 (job id 2026-03-20-09). I'm checking execution logs now.

mike.infra: Quick mitigation option: route ap-southeast traffic to the EU fallback pool (runbook: /ops/runbooks/regional-fallback). Higher latency but keeps services up. Want me to flip? :fire_engine:

sara.sec: Yes flip traffic to fallback for now. Also enable verbose unwrap/debug logging on the KMS plugin for ap-southeast. @kms-audit-bot can you re-ingest ap-southeast KMS logs for the last 2 hours and surface any decrypt attempts lacking request_id?

kms-audit-bot: Received re-ingest job. Job 5729 queued. Will post any matching decrypt events with missing correlation headers to #eng-ml-alerts and append to INC-2026-015.

alex.runtime: Longer term we need: 1) ensure proxy forwards x-rw-request-id on every unwrap call, 2) make audit_exporter treat missing request_id as a bad signal (alert), and 3) add an e2e test that rotates a key and validates unwrap success + audit entry. I'll draft a checklist.

ian.oncall: Action items (short):
- Route ap-southeast -> eu fallback (mike)
- Temporarily restore kms:Decrypt to proxy.role in ap-southeast for 30m (mike)
- Enable verbose unwrap logs (sara)
- Open incident and notify compliance (sara/carol)

mike.infra: I rolled a temporary RBAC rollback to include kms:Decrypt for roles/proxy.edge in ap-southeast & ap-east at 04:58:31 UTC. Monitoring handshake metrics now.

deploy-bot: Policy change deployed: iam-policy/rollback-proxy-kms-2026-03-20 by mike.infra at 2026-03-20T04:58:31Z.

sara.sec: Handshakes returned to nominal in ~6m after the rollback and routing change. Leaving verbose logs on for 1h and will collect the timeframe for postmortem. Opening incident ticket INC-2026-015 and attaching logs.

carol.compliance: Noted. I'll prepare an initial timeline and pre-notify SOC. Request: pause any further automated RBAC pruning in regions until we have mandatory correlation headers and a target audit SLO. We'll need a formal change justification for the temporary rollback.

sara.sec: Agreed. Postmortem owners: sara.sec (sec-eng), mike.infra (infra), alex.runtime (runtime). Next steps: collect unwrap plugin traces, correlate with kms-audit-bot output, and add a e2e guard in CI that simulates role-scope changes.

mike.infra: Monitoring dashboards: handshake_rejects -> down to baseline. I'll keep the temporary role for 30m then remove and validate the correlation headers first.

sara.sec: Thanks all. I'll paste the raw logs into INC-2026-015 and leave verbose on until 05:55 UTC. If anyone spots new denies, ping here and tag @ian.oncall. :lock:
